title: J1939 Node Configuration
text: Configure J1939 node with address and network management attributes, 2 outputs; {Config name} sets the iD of the J1939 network configuration to associate with this node, {Node name} sets the name of this J1939, {Message} sets the nine network attributes as defined by the database file consistent with the J1939 protocol vector, {Sample time} sets the simulation refresh rate, {Output current node address} enables or disable the Address port display and {Output address claim status} enables or disable the address claim AC Status. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Address
ports.summary: Returns the effective address of the node int8

ports.name: AC Status
ports.summary: Indicates the success (1) or failure (0) of the node’s address claim 0 | 1

params.name: Config name
params.values: ID of the J1939 network configuration to associate with this node ConfigX (default) | character vector

params.name: Node name
params.values: name of this J1939 node NodeX (default) | character vector

params.name: Message
params.values: Nine network attributes as defined by the database file consistent with the J1939 protocol vector array

params.name: Output current node address
params.values: Enable or disable the Address port display off (default) | on

params.name: Output address claim status
params.values: Enable or disable the address claim AC Status display off (default) | on
